mapper.select: SELECT id, email, password, name, phone_number, created_at, updated_at FROM members ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE members SET email = #{email}, password = #{password}, name = #{name}, phone_number = #{phoneNumber}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
